provider_visible_rules.conversation_expectation: Natural engineering dialogue with task background, evidence, one direction change, completed work, the remaining information gap, and a final request. Do not solve the final engineering task.
provider_visible_rules.pair_rule: Positive and Negative share identity, snapshot, shared messages, workspace and exactly the same query. Only the appended delta message changes. Positive keeps one frozen gap; Negative supplies exactly that fact.

world_facts: T09-L0-01 contains the exact prior air-gap wrapper decision for nebula-console: fixed cache .audit-cache/2026-07-15 and output build/audit/trivy.raw.json; nearby sessions contain online and container-scan alternatives.

T09-L0-03 is the complete risk-catalog review session that records the accepted NVD-then-GHSA-then-vendor CVSS fallback after two rejected alternatives; a search result supplies the session id and the full reasoning requires the complete session.

T09-L1-01 records the accepted audit policy: include HIGH and CRITICAL only, preserve a missing fixed version as an empty field, and never infer a vulnerability result not present in the frozen scan JSON.
T09-L1-05 records the approved CSV column order: vulnerability_id, package_name, installed_version, fixed_version, severity, cvss_score.
T09-L1-09 is a decision memory dated 2026-07-28 and typed decision: routine upgrade reviews must separate compatibility work from scan-result extraction.
T09-L2-01 at /security/audit/offline-runbook contains the exact mapping from Trivy process exit conditions to the team audit wrapper result; its injected summary must not reveal that mapping.
L3 contains only stable principles: do not run a real release or security scan during planning, prefer frozen inputs, and distinguish discovery from reporting. It contains no case answer.

skills.adaptation_policy: Read the frozen raw files. Preserve names and all core technical steps. You may only propose neutral listing descriptions plus explicit use_when and do_not_use_when boundaries, and may replace unsupported host-tool names if one occurs. Do not invent any Skill or procedure.
routing_boundaries: Use trivy-offline-vulnerability-scanning only when a dependency artifact still must be scanned with a fixed offline Trivy database; do not use it when scan JSON already exists, for SAST, or for an ordinary version bump.
Use cvss-score-extraction when vulnerability records already exist and CVSS source priority or missing-score fallback is the gap; do not use it to scan or format a complete CSV.
Use vulnerability-csv-reporting when parsed findings already exist and the missing procedure is filtering/field mapping/CSV formatting; do not use it to discover findings.
Use dependency-upgrade for compatibility-aware version upgrades; do not use it to determine the vulnerability set from an unscanned lockfile.
Use sast-configuration for source-code static analysis configuration; do not use it for software composition analysis of package-lock.json.
Use fortify-remediate only for already-detected Fortify SAST/DAST findings. The resource-read case requires references/sast-dast-implementation.md after the listed Skill is opened.
